# AI Connect Inc.

> A Seoul-based company digitalizing premium metabolic health — care that previously required expensive equipment, specialist clinics, and dedicated coordinators is now accessible to anyone with a smartphone.

AI Connect Inc. builds AI-powered wellness products. The core product is HAVIT, a metabolic-health companion app that takes users through diagnosis → prescription → daily adaptive coaching. The mission: a healthy, vibrant life for every single person in the world, delivered through a smartphone rather than a clinic.

## Sections of This Site

- [Hero — Mission](https://www.aiconnects.me/#hero): "A healthy, vibrant life for every single person in the world"
- [Team / Builders](https://www.aiconnects.me/#builder): the people behind AI Connect
- [Company History](https://www.aiconnects.me/#history): milestones from founding to current product
- [How HAVIT Works](https://www.aiconnects.me/#close): metabolic-science diagnosis → personalized prescription → coaching

## Products & Ecosystem

- [HAVIT (product site)](https://www.aihavit.com/): the metabolic wellness app — features, validation, downloads
- [Get the HAVIT App](https://app.aihavit.com/): platform-detecting universal link → iOS / Android
- [HAVIT Blog](https://blog.aihavit.com/): 1,086+ science-backed wellness articles in 10 languages
- [Wellness Calculators](https://blog.aihavit.com/en/tools): BMR/TDEE, protein, hydration, caffeine cutoff, sleep cycle
